tools.name: build_plan
tools.description: Rebuild the plan with the three CLI lines a human types: `python3 lhc_plan_json.py build <plan_dir>` collects the leaves into plan.graph.json; `python3 lhc_grid.py render <plan_dir>/plan.graph.json --out-dir <plan_dir>` regenerates plan.html and plan.md of that graph (the page is regenerated by the build, which is why there is no separate render tool); `python3 lhc_plan_json.py check <plan_dir>` validates the leaves and writes nothing. Every output is returned verbatim.

handoff.description: Also check handoff readiness for the plan's declared decomposition; default false.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Price one leaf with the existing estimator: `python3 lhc_models.py [--offline] [--catalog <file>] cost --model <model> --minutes <n> [--tier <tier>]`. The catalog answer is returned verbatim; this facade never computes or guesses a price itself.

model.description: Model string to resolve in the live catalog.

minutes.description: Estimated active minutes of the leaf.

tier.description: Optional tier gate the estimator applies: fast, frontier, unknown.

offline.description: Price from the cached catalog only.

catalog.description: Pin the catalog to this JSON file.

tools.name: update_progress
tools.description: Add a progress note to a running leaf. Refused when the leaf is past twice its estimate and 45 minutes: then close the proven part and split the rest by object.

actor.description: Declared caller ref; never native metadata.

tools.name: publish_html
tools.description: Invoke the canonical CLI: publish_html

tools.name: revise_plan
tools.description: Invoke the canonical CLI: revise_plan

tools.name: show_plan
tools.description: Where the plan is: done leaves with their results, the current leaves with their last note, what runs elsewhere, what is next, overruns and Workers not merged yet. Call it first after a compaction or a resume, before anything else.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Set plan.json fields (goal, recon, acceptance_scenario, ...) and/or append one revision {reason, summary}. Validated before writing; a wrong field or shape is an error that says the allowed form. Never edit plan.json by hand.

revision.description: {"reason": why the plan changed, "summary": what changed}

actor.description: Declared caller ref; never native metadata.

tools.description: Start a leaf in this session (status running, bound to the session so the hooks show it after a compaction).

actor.description: Declared caller ref; never native metadata.

tools.name: worker_register
tools.description: Bind the Worker of a leaf before it starts: its id, its branch, its own worktree and, on a shared stand, its run directory (run_host for another machine).

actor.description: Declared caller ref; never native metadata.

tools.name: worker_finish
tools.description: Close a Worker's leaf: merge its branch into the task branch (task_worktree), remove its worktree, branch and run directory, then mark the leaf done with the result. A conflict aborts the merge and leaves the leaf open.

result.description: What works; where: files, commit, receipt; not proven: ...

actor.description: Declared caller ref; never native metadata.

tools.description: Record every discovered bug or failed test, including failures predating this task. Never delete records.

plan_dir.description: Existing LHC task/plan directory; records live in bugs/*.json.

title.description: Observed error title, including pre-existing test failures.

details.description: What failed and how it was observed; avoid private data.

source.description: Test command, user report or incident source.

reporter.description: Discovering worker identity; never omit baseline failures.

tools.name: bug_get
tools.description: Read one immutable-history bug and its optimistic concurrency SHA.

plan_dir.description: Existing LHC task/plan directory; records live in bugs/*.json.

tools.name: bug_list
tools.description: List all recorded bugs and their status/history; missing or corrupt records never count green.

plan_dir.description: Existing LHC task/plan directory; records live in bugs/*.json.

status.description: List filter or resolve state: fixed, duplicate, false_positive.

tools.name: bug_update
tools.description: Update metadata or block/reopen one bug with CAS; cannot erase history or mark fixed.

plan_dir.description: Existing LHC task/plan directory; records live in bugs/*.json.

expected_sha256.description: SHA from get/list; stale competing updates fail.

fields.description: Partial metadata; status may be open/blocked, never fixed here.

tools.name: bug_resolve
tools.description: Fixed requires TDD proof: the failing run before the fix and the passing run after it, both as files; duplicate/false-positive require explicit reason.

plan_dir.description: Existing LHC task/plan directory; records live in bugs/*.json.

expected_sha256.description: SHA from get/list; stale competing updates fail.

status.description: List filter or resolve state: fixed, duplicate, false_positive.

duplicate_of.description: Registered original bug id when duplicate.

evidence.description: Fixed only, TDD: red_proof_path + red_result (the test failing before the fix), proof_path + test_command + result (the same test passing after it). Proof files are hashed.

tools.name: bug_check
tools.description: Final-worker gate: fail if any recorded bug is open or blocked. Green tests and deploy still required.
